node.statement: For fixed n define Gamma_n:B(A)->B(M_n tensor A) by Gamma_n(U)([x_ij])=[U(x_ij)]. This map is bounded: coordinate compression in the concrete operator space gives ||x_ij||<=||X|| for X=[x_ij], while [U(x_ij)]=sum_{i,j} E_ij tensor U(x_ij) and ||E_ij tensor y||=||y||, hence ||Gamma_n(U)X||<=n^2||U||||X|| and ||Gamma_n(U)||<=n^2||U||. Entrywise evaluation also gives Gamma_n(I)=I and Gamma_n(UV)=Gamma_n(U)Gamma_n(V). Thus Gamma_n is a continuous unital algebra homomorphism; no isometry or uniform-in-n bound is asserted. By validated node 1.2.1, Gamma_n(T_{P,Q})=T_{P_n,Q_n}.
